title: Fleet Governor: scaling playback, throughput timeline, and audit diff view
creator: Maya Singh
description: Build a Fleet Governor UI surface in the Console that lets operators: inspect historical scaling decisions (a searchable playback), visualize fleet-level throughput with an adjustable time scrubber, and compare configuration changes with an audit diff view. The goal is to make it easy for SREs and platform owners to understand why slots scaled up or down, to replay decisions against real traffic windows, and to quickly rollback or pin a prior autoscaling policy when regressions are observed.
acceptance_criteria: Playback timeline shows scaling events, autoscale policy triggers, and synthetic replay controls for any selected 24h window
Throughput dashboard displays per-fleet and per-model TPS, queue depth, and 95/99 latency with selectable aggregation (1m/5m/1h)
Audit diff view surfaces policy field-level changes (min/max instances, burst window, target latency) with author, timestamp, and PR link
Operators can pin a historical policy and apply it to a fleet in a single action with confirmation and dry-run option
RBAC: only users with fleet:manage permission see rollback/pin actions; audit trail entries are created for any policy application
Console links to cost projection for the selected policy and window (estimated token/GPU cost delta)
End-to-end e2e and integration tests cover playback rendering, diff generation, and apply/rollback flows
